## How it was checked

<!-- Remove lines that do not apply. Mark done ones with [x]. Say what you did not run, and why. -->

- [ ] The failing test came first, and fails for the right reason without the change
- [ ] `pnpm format` and `pnpm check` pass
- [ ] Browser suites or journeys run (`pnpm test:browser`, `pnpm test:e2e`), or left to CI
- [ ] A `patch` changeset for each published package changed (`pnpm changeset`)
- [ ] Docs changed where behaviour changed
